posts.title: My definition of a ‘Personal’ Trainer
posts.description: For almost a decade and a half, I have dedicated my time and energy to helping others recognize and progress toward their health and wellness goals. Notice I did not say ‘achieve’. To be honest, most people I have worked with achieve something far different than what they initially thought. I hope other personal trainers would admit the same. […]
